text:
Sam G: Heads-up — we need choreography for next week's feature-flag cutover: tenant-priority routing change. Core goals: minimize blast radius, clear rollback, customer opt-out, SLA handoff.
Marta L: Draft outline below. 3-phase canary, per-tenant opt-out, telemetry gates, and an emergency soft-kill to fallback model.
Indra K: +1. We should include a holdback cohort for A/B quality checks and shadow traffic to the new variant during phase 1.
sre-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled window proposal: 2026-04-01 02:00 UTC. Auto-abort if api_error_rate > 3% OR p50_latency > 120ms sustained for 5m.
Priya S: Reminder — enterprise customers want explicit 24h rollback SLA and an opt-out toggle we can flip on their behalf. Also need customer-facing comms draft. :loudspeaker:
Sam G: For scope, keep change limited to model routing logic + feature flag. No schema changes. Ops must be able to toggle per-tenant instantly.
Marta L: Proposal (short):
```json
{
  "flag": "tenant_routing_v2",
  "phases": [
    {"name": "internal-canary", "pct": 1, "audience": "employees"},
    {"name": "partner-beta", "pct": 5, "audience": "selected-tenants"},
    {"name": "ramp", "pct": 25, "audience": "gradual-slices"}
  ],
  "metrics": {
    "abort_conditions": {
      "api_error_rate_pct": 3,
      "p50_latency_ms": 120,
      "quality_regression_pct": 2
    },
    "canary_window_minutes": 30
  },
  "fallback": "route_to:m-small-model",
  "ops_commands": ["/ops toggle tenant_routing_v2 <tenant> <on|off>", "/ops rollback-featureflag tenant_routing_v2"]
}
```
Indra K: For quality checks we'll run evals against two prompt sets: `onboarding-critical` and `billing-critical`. Threshold: BLEU-ish/score drop < 1.5% and NPS-style manual review if borderline. We'll stream diff samples to #eng-ml.
sre-bot: Canary controls: sample-size target >= 2000 requests per phase OR 30m min window. Health hooks -> pager if abort condition triggers. Also add cost delta monitor: token_cost_delta > 10% -> alert.
Priya S: Sales ask: we need a per-tenant consent flow + a simple UI toggle in the console for partner success to flip. Also include a rollback contact list (CS + Eng oncall).
Sam G: Runbook owners: Marta = runbook + flag config, Indra = evals & quality gate, SRE = infra guardrails & pager mappings, Priya = customer comms + opt-out process.
Marta L: I'll draft the runbook this afternoon. It will include step-by-step: pre-checks, canary launch commands, monitoring dashboard links, escalation ladder, and emergency soft-kill: `route override --target m-small --reason "rollback"`.
Indra K: Quick note on experiments: do not run A/B on enterprise tenants. Use a separate experimental cohort. Also log full inputs for 72h in secure bucket for audit.
sre-bot: Ops checklist (short):
- Ensure per-tenant flag toggle is tested in staging
- Add api keys for partner beta tenants
- Create dashboard with these panels: api_error_rate, p50_latency, quality_regression, token_cost_delta
- Pager mapping ready (@oncall-eng)

Priya S: Communication draft outline: 1) What changes; 2) Why; 3) Opt-out steps; 4) SLA and rollback commitments; 5) Contact and timeline. I'll start copy.
Sam G: Two decisions we need before Wed sync: final phase percentages and exact abort thresholds (metric names + numeric). Also confirm who signs off the go/no-go at T-1h.
Marta L: I'll propose numbers and a one-pager; flag config will be in infra repo PR.
Indra K: I will prepare the eval harness and run a shadow test during internal-canary.
sre-bot: Noted. I'll schedule the guardrail checks and add abort automation to the deploy job.
Sam G: LGTM. Schedule runbook review meeting Wed 15:00 UTC. Ping when drafts are ready. :thumbsup:
Priya S: Ack — I'll loop in two POCs from Customer Success for the opt-out verification.
Marta L: Draft PR + runbook link will be posted here when ready.
Sam G: Thanks all — keeping scope tight should make rollback straightforward.
